content.text: {"issues":[{"where":"Question 3 — CIP protocol development","problem":"Pure water flux recovery measured against current production CIP performance only checks whether the new protocol cleans as well as the existing one, not whether any protocol is adequate for a 72-hour run; a method that scores well on this measure could still leave the fouling problem unsolved.","fix":"Replace the measure with flux recovery after a scripted 72-hour production-representative run, with a pass criterion tied to the nominal flux target, not to current practice."},{"where":"Question 4 / Phase 3 — Production skid validation","problem":"The two years of existing batch logs record fouled, double-CIP runs and cannot serve as a baseline for nominal-flux 72-hour performance, because no such runs exist in the dataset.","fix":"Define the performance baseline as the membrane manufacturer's rated flux and the company's nominal 72-hour run specification, not the historical batch logs."}],"unconfirmed":["Access to production UF skid and bench-scale fermentation setup","Research staff (part-time) for fouling analysis and protocol development"]}
